Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

CF Benchmarks is the leading regulated cryptocurrency index provider, authorized as a registered benchmark administrator under the UK Benchmarks Regulation. Its indices are integrated into six of the eleven spot Bitcoin ETFs in the US and power 99% of the regulated crypto derivatives market, with over $40 billion in assets referencing its benchmarks.

We are looking for a Java Developer to join the CF Benchmarks Index Team. You will be responsible for implementing new financial benchmarks and for ensuring the smooth running of the CF Benchmarks platform.

You should be diligent with a keen attention to detail and a track record of seeing tasks/projects through to conclusion. The ideal candidate should have experience working as a developer within fintech for at least 3 years.

To learn more about CF Benchmarks, please click here

 

The opportunity

  • Build benchmark calculation systems based on new and innovative methodologies

  • Work closely with the product team to develop new features supporting business requirements in an end to end manner

  • Broadly contribute in the areas of data analysis, core infrastructure, core backend, business logic implementations and more

  • Support a 24/7 real-time distributed system as part of a wider team

  • Help ensuring all systems have suitable coverage with tests, metrics and alarms

  • Help provide world class pricing and data services to the crypto and financial world

  • Be part of one of the fastest growing crypto companies in the world

 
 

What you bring

  • Experience in software development, with a focus on backend development

  • Possess a solid foundation of Java applications

  • Ability to develop iteratively for a high throughput, real time system

  • Highly capable of writing maintainable, simple, efficient and dependable code

  • Understanding of modern development processes such as CI/CD, Git

  • Strong mathematical and reasoning skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and as part of a team

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Experience working with benchmarks or pricing models, or broader financial knowledge

  • Experience working with cryptocurrency or blockchain technology

  • Experience working with SQL and data analytics skills

  • Familiarity with common middlewares such as RPC, protobuf, message queues, Redis

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

The Inventory Supervisor will work closely with Procurement, Operations, and Logistics to ensure inventory processes are efficient, accurate, and aligned with business needs. This role will also be responsible for supervising inventory staff, maintaining accurate inventory records and data, monitoring inventory levels, and identifying opportunities to improve processes and overall supply chain efficiency.

What you'll do

  • Collaborate with management, administrative, operations, maintenance, and construction teams to align inventory levels with operational needs.
  • Communicate effectively with suppliers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to resolve inventory-related issues.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for inventory-related inquiries and concerns.
  • Use RF unit to scan incoming shipments 
  • Keep strict batch records and received shipment records 
  • Rotate stock and track as needed 
  • Upload Received Shipment forms into ERP system

  • Train inventory staff, ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures.
  • Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members, providing guidance and support as needed.
  • Conduct performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback to team members.
  • Monitor stock levels to ensure availability of necessary supplies and parts for continuous mining operations.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and safety standards related to inventory management.
  • Implement and maintain safe handling and storage practices for all inventory items.
  • Receive all incoming deliveries and packages and track delivery to departments

What you'll bring

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in inventory management, warehouse operations, or a related field, preferably in a technical or industrial environment.
  • Strong knowledge of inventory management principles, practices, processes, and inventory management systems.
  • Proficiency in NetSuite and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret inventory data, identify discrepancies, and make informed operational decisions.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in inventory records, reporting, and documentation.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to supervise, motivate, and develop team members.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, determine root causes, and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effectively working with suppliers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize responsibilities, manage deadlines, and maintain efficiency in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Procurement, Operations, and Logistics.
  • Ability to adapt to changing business needs, operational priorities, and inventory demands.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, work independently, and take ownership of inventory-related responsibilities.

Physical requirements and work environment

  • Ability to stand, walk, and perform repetitive tasks for extended periods
  • Ability to lift and move equipment as needed (25lbs)
  • Ability to work onsite in a data center environment (heat, noise, etc.)
  • Exposure to high noise levels and varying temperatures

Safety Requirements

  • PPE & Compliance: Strictly adhere to all site safety protocols and wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all times (e.g., safety glasses, hearing protection, steel-toed boots).

Pipeline proficiency: Deep background in technical data modeling and building robust production data pipelines.

High-growth adaptability: The ability to thrive, execute, and deliver consistently in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.

Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.

We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

About the Role

People build lives across borders, and Aspora moves their money with them. Aisha is our next bet: an AI finance agent for NRIs that does the work end to end. Most agent companies build the intelligence and hope the rails come later. We already have the rails. This role exists to build the intelligence NRIs will trust with real money.

You will own Aisha completely: product, roadmap, team and results. You’ll report directly to our CEO. You’ll work closely with compliance, legal and our payments teams across the UAE, UK and India. The hard calls are yours: what to build, buy or partner on, and when the agent is ready to act.

Who You Are

To you, an AI agent is only worth building if it finishes the job. You’ve built consumer products people rely on every day, and you’ve shipped AI that holds up in the real world.

  • You’ve built consumer before. You founded or ran a product people used daily, and you know what users forgive and what loses their trust for good.

  • You’ve shipped AI that works in production. You have operated evals, orchestration, tool use and failure modes yourself, not just read about them.

  • You bring money-grade judgement. You’ve worked where mistakes move other people’s money, or you can show you learn regulated domains fast.

  • You lead by doing. You stay close enough to the product and the code to make the call yourself.

  • You’ve moved quickly everywhere you’ve been. Your track record shows people kept trusting you with more, sooner than expected.

  • You’ve been tested. A failed launch, a company that died or a regulatory wall. You made sound calls under pressure and followed through to the end.

Most importantly, you want to prove that AI can be trusted with people’s money.

What You’ll Own

This role comes with a founder’s mandate, inside a company that already has licences, partners and customers.

  • Own Aisha end to end. Take it from early build to a product NRIs trust with real money tasks.

  • Shape the agent stack. Decide what to build, buy or partner on across models, orchestration, data connections and agent payment rails.

  • Make reliability the product. Build an agent that completes long, multi-step tasks, with evals, guardrails and failure modes treated as core features.

  • Ship consumer-grade experiences. Own onboarding, activation and retention, starting with a hundred research sessions a week that you recruit yourself.

  • Build the founding team. Hire senior engineers first, then add design and data as the product earns them.

  • Act safely on licensed rails. Partner with compliance and legal so the agent can move money without ever becoming the incident.

What you build will decide how far Aspora goes beyond payments, and how fast we get there.

Why Aspora

  • You’ll define what a trustworthy AI finance agent looks like, and own the outcome it delivers.

  • You’ll work directly with our CEO, with compliance, legal and payments as partners from day one.

  • You’ll build on licences, bank partnerships and live corridors that most agent startups spend years chasing.

  • You’ll own product, roadmap, team and results from the day you join.

  • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is seeking a Fixed Asset Business Manager to establish and manage the operating model that connects data center asset operations, maintenance activity, project execution, and fixed asset accounting.

In this role, you will architect the business processes, data standards, controls, and integrations required to translate changes in the physical asset environment within the CMMS platform, Nuvolo into complete, timely, and supportable fixed asset records in the ERP system, NetSuite. You will serve as the primary business partner between the Data Center Asset Manager and the Senior Fixed Asset Accountant, ensuring that asset additions, replacements, upgrades, maintenance activities, transfers, retirements, and disposals are properly identified, classified, documented, and routed for accounting treatment.

This role does not own the operational asset-management strategy or perform fixed asset accounting activities such as capitalization entries and depreciation processing in NetSuite. Instead, you will own the connective tissue between those functions: defining how asset events originate in Nuvolo, how relevant information is captured and validated, and how it flows to NetSuite for accounting review and processing.

What you'll do

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve the end-to-end process linking physical asset activity, work orders, maintenance records, and asset lifecycle events in the CMMS platform, Nuvolo to fixed asset records in the ERP system, NetSuite.
  • Partner with the Data Center Asset Manager to align Nuvolo asset hierarchy, asset identifiers, tagging standards, classification schemes, location data, and lifecycle-status requirements with NetSuite fixed asset reporting and accounting needs.
  • Partner with the Senior Fixed Asset Accountant to translate NetSuite fixed asset and accounting requirements into practical Nuvolo workflows, mandatory data fields, supporting documentation, and system controls.
  • Lead the business requirements, process design, testing, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of integrations and interfaces between Nuvolo and NetSuite.
  • Work with IT, platform, data, and system owners to define CMMS-to-ERP data mappings, integration triggers, validation rules, error handling, data ownership, and controls.
  • Establish mechanisms to connect work orders, maintenance activities, component replacements, commissioning events, and decommissioning activity to the relevant physical asset and corresponding EPR fixed asset record, where applicable.
  • Develop business rules and escalation workflows to identify operations work that may require accounting review, including capitalizable betterments, component replacements, asset retirements, transfers, and disposals.
  • Establish recurring reconciliations between CMMS asset registers and the ERP fixed asset records; investigate, assign, track, and resolve data and process exceptions.
  • Develop reporting that provides visibility into CMMS-to-ERP integration status, asset-event volume, reconciliation results, exception aging, data quality, and financial-readiness risks.
  • Coordinate with the Senior Fixed Asset Accountant to ensure accounting-relevant operational events are delivered with the supporting information required for accounting capitalization, retirement, transfer, or other fixed asset processing.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (e.g., Business Administration with an accounting focus, or Management Information Systems).
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in fixed asset accounting, capital asset management, finance transformation, or business systems analysis within capital-intensive industries (such as data centers, high-tech manufacturing, energy, telecommunications, or utilities).
  • Strong technical comprehension of fixed asset accounting principles, including capitalization thresholds, componentization, betterments versus routine maintenance, asset de-recognition, transfers, and disposals.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience working with an ERP system, such as NetSuite, with specific exposure to fixed asset subledger management, capital project records, and purchasing modules.
  • Demonstrated experience working with a CMMS platform, such as Nuvolo or an equivalent enterprise work and asset management platform (e.g., ServiceNow EAM, Maximo, TRIRIGA), including an understanding of equipment hierarchies, work orders, and asset status tracking.
  • Proven experience designing, testing, or managing business requirements for integrations, automated data interfaces, or reconciliation workflows between operational maintenance systems and ERP subledgers.
  • Experience establishing internal controls, audit trails, and physical-to-book reconciliation frameworks compliant with SOX and internal audit standards.
  • Strong analytical and data-manipulation skills, with the ability to reconcile disparate datasets, investigate systemic anomalies, and identify process bottlenecks.
  • Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical engineering and operational workflows into accounting requirements and vice versa.

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Competitive Salary: $150,000 - $175,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant. 
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. 
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans. 
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Please note - for candidates living within 35 miles of a Stripe office (San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Chicago or Georgia) we operate a hybrid work policy where 50% office attendance per month is expected. For candidates more than 35 miles from an office, fully remote work can be approved. 

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Partner Solutions Engineering sits within Global Partnerships at the intersection of Stripe’s Product and Engineering teams and the partners that extend Stripe’s platform. We own the partner-side technical outcome for selected partnership work, from architecture and implementation through testing, launch readiness, and production support.

The Ecosystem Partner Solutions Engineering team helps partners build high-quality integrations across Stripe’s app and developer-platform ecosystem. We work across areas such as developer tools, commerce, billing, automation, and data, while helping Stripe turn recurring partner needs into stronger products and reusable integration paths.

Our work has two forms. We deliver priority partner implementations, and we turn the lessons from those implementations into Product feedback, reference architectures, testing and certification paths, and reusable guidance. This allows Stripe to support more partners without treating every implementation as a bespoke project.

What you’ll do

As a Partner Solutions Engineer, Ecosystem, you will own the technical outcome for a portfolio of ecosystem areas and priority partner integrations. You will work directly with partners, Partner Development Managers, Product Managers, and Engineers to move opportunities from technical discovery through implementation and launch.

You will also develop deep expertise in selected parts of Stripe’s app and developer platform. You will identify recurring technical barriers, help Product teams distinguish isolated partner requests from broader platform needs, and create reusable paths that improve the next partner’s experience.

This is a hands-on, partner-facing engineering role. The strongest candidates can move comfortably between partner architecture, API and code-level debugging, Product feedback, delivery planning, and executive communication.

Responsibilities

Own partner technical delivery

  • Own technical planning, architecture, implementation support, testing, and launch readiness for selected partner integrations.
  • Translate partner goals into clear technical requirements, dependencies, milestones, and success criteria.
  • Maintain one accountable technical plan across the partner, Global Partnerships, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Identify delivery risks early and drive technical decisions through launch.
  • Lead critical partner escalations and help resolve complex production integration failures.

Manage an ecosystem portfolio

  • Own a technical portfolio across multiple ecosystem areas, based on team priorities and your expertise.
  • Partner with partnership leads to prioritize integrations and determine where dedicated technical support will create the most value.
  • Connect partner technical delivery to adoption, commercial, and user outcomes.
  • Prioritize technical engagements based on partner impact, strategic value, implementation readiness, and team commitments.

Develop platform expertise

  • Develop deep expertise in Stripe’s app, developer-platform, and extensibility capabilities.
  • Advise partners and other Partner Solutions Engineers on embedded experiences, workflow automation, application distribution, permissions, and monetization.
  • Maintain reference architectures, implementation guidance, testing standards, and certification paths.
  • Track emerging platform capabilities and help priority partners adopt them successfully.

Influence Stripe’s Product roadmap

  • Identify recurring friction and unmet partner needs through direct implementation work.
  • Distinguish partner-specific requirements from platform gaps that affect multiple integrations.
  • Translate implementation evidence into clear Product requirements and recommendations.
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to reach clear decisions on requirements, workarounds, ownership, and sequencing.
  • Close the feedback loop with partners when Stripe makes or declines a Product investment.

Create reusable technical leverage

  • Turn initial partner builds into repeatable implementation and enablement paths.
  • Build prototypes, examples, scripts, or lightweight tooling when they accelerate partner delivery or validate a Product direction.
  • Define launch-readiness standards across permissions, authorization, testing, observability, and production support.
  • Transition mature integration patterns to scalable support models when they no longer require dedicated engineering ownership.
  • Contribute to shared team standards for custom partner applications, incidents, escalations, and partner handoffs.

Measure outcomes

  • Define and track technical milestones, launch outcomes, adoption signals, and implementation quality.
  • Measure the commercial, user, or Product outcomes that your work enables, accelerates, or protects.
  • Use portfolio data to identify repeated blockers, improve prioritization, and guide future investment.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. Preferred qualifications are useful but not required.

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in solutions engineering, partner engineering, software engineering, technical consulting, developer relations engineering, or another hands-on technical role supporting external users or partners.
  • Experience designing and delivering production integrations using APIs, webhooks, authentication and authorization, event-driven systems, or developer platforms.
  • Ability to read, write, and debug code in at least one general-purpose programming language such as JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Java, or Go.
  • Experience diagnosing complex integration failures across partner systems, APIs, and product surfaces.
  • Experience leading external partners from technical discovery through implementation, testing, and launch.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous partner goals into a clear architecture, delivery plan, and set of technical decisions.
  • Ability to identify patterns across multiple implementations and turn them into reusable guidance or Product requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Experience working across Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Sales, or other cross-functional teams without relying on direct authority.
  • Sound judgment when balancing partner urgency, Product constraints, implementation quality, and long-term platform leverage.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with developer platforms, platform ecosystems, marketplaces, or partner-distributed products.
  • Experience with application extensibility, embedded applications, workflow automation, OAuth, or delegated API access.
  • Experience with payments, fintech, commerce, billing, monetization, or financial operations.
  • Experience creating partner certification, integration-quality, or launch-readiness programs.
  • Experience building prototypes, examples, or developer tooling that influenced a Product roadmap or accelerated partner adoption.

What success looks like

In this role, you will:

  • Launch priority partner integrations that produce measurable user, adoption, commercial, or Product outcomes.
  • Give partners one accountable technical owner through implementation and launch.
  • Improve Stripe’s Products by bringing clear, repeated partner evidence into roadmap decisions.
  • Reduce repeated partner blockers through reusable architecture, guidance, testing, and certification.
  • Develop recognized expertise across your assigned ecosystem areas and Stripe’s app and developer-platform capabilities.
  • Increase the number of partner integrations that can move to scalable support models without sacrificing quality.

Riot is seeking a Critical Vendor Manager to own the vendor relationship program for Riot's maintenance and repair critical vendors — the trade vendors (electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety, water treatment, and similar categories) that perform maintenance and repair work across the data center portfolio. 

You will design and run the vendor performance management program: KPI tracking and scorecarding in both directions — Riot's assessment of vendors, and a defined path for vendors to provide constructive feedback on Riot — continuous-improvement tracking, and program-level effectiveness evaluation. Day-to-day vendor relationship management sits with site teams; this role owns the program framework, standards, and metrics they operate within. This position is remote/hybrid, with regular travel to the Rockdale or and Riots sites.

  • Own the vendor relationship program for maintenance and repair critical vendors across the portfolio — setting program structure, governance, and performance metrics, and evaluating program effectiveness at the portfolio level 
  • Design and maintain vendor performance scorecards and KPI tracking for maintenance and repair critical vendors, covering quality, safety, schedule adherence, and conformance to the Vendor Management Standard 
  • Build and run the reciprocal feedback process — vendors formally scoring Riot's performance as a partner, with a defined path for vendors to provide constructive feedback 
  • Set and track continuous-improvement metrics in partnership with vendors, driving shared improvement initiatives rather than one-directional scorekeeping 
  • Serve as the escalation intermediary for site teams raising vendor performance or coverage issues, working the issue to resolution or to a documented corrective action 
  • Execute vendor selection evaluations and onboarding verification for maintenance and repair critical vendor scopes, in partnership with site Critical Operations Managers and per the Vendor Management Standard
